# dsh-web-search-yuanbao
English | 中文
## Summary
With `dsh-web-search-yuanbao`, the harness searches the web through Tencent Yuanbao Search and gets
titles, URLs, excerpts, and publication dates from one direct API request. Choose it when a deployme
nt holds a Tencent Cloud WSA API key and wants Yuanbao's search index without an auxiliary model tur
n. The provider maps `passage` (or a vertical result's `content`) to `snippet`, normalizes the servi
ce's date format to ISO-8601, and drops entries without a URL or excerpt. The model-facing `web_sear
ch` tool lives in `dsh-tool-web`.
## Use this package
Mount the provider in a composition that already loads the web service; it registers as the `yuanbao
` search provider, so `ctx.web.search()` resolves it automatically when it is the only usable search
backend — or pin it with `searchProvider: yuanbao`.
### Install into a profile
The package declares a `dsh.bundle` layer, so `dsh plugin` installs it and adds the provider row for

The layer inserts the provider beside the base `web` row. Select it by setting `searchProvider: yuan
bao` on that row in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (or leave it as the only usable search back
end). Store the key through the credentials service, or export `TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY` in the laun
key through the credentials service, or export `TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY` in the launch environment.
### When to choose it
Choose this backend when a deployment has a Tencent Cloud Yuanbao Search API key and wants one direc
t retrieval request per query. Unlike `dsh-web-search-deepseek`, no model turn runs for a search, so
latency and cost scale with the retrieval API alone. The provider is unavailable when the endpoint
base does not parse; the configuration schema rejects any count other than 10, 20, 30, 40, or 50. A
missing credential is reported when the search runs.
### Minimal configuration
Load the web service and the provider; the API key resolves through `ctx.credentials` when that serv
ice is mounted, otherwise from `$TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY` in the launch environment.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `apiKey` | omitted | Literal API key; prefer `apiKeyEnv` so no secret enters configuration |
| `ap
iKeyEnv` | `TENCENTCLOUD_WSA_APIKEY` | Credential reference resolved for each search; a non-empty li

teral `apiKey` wins |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.wsa.cloud.tencent.com` | Endpoint base; `/SearchPro

` is appended. An unparseable value makes the provider unavailable |
| `count` | `10` | Results per
search when the request carries no bound; one of 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. An unsupported value makes the
provider unavailable |
The generated configuration catalog is the exhaustive source for every accepted field and its JSDoc.
### What a search returns
Each usable page maps to a `WebSearchSource`: `url`, `title` when present, `snippet` from `passage`
(a vertical result falls back to `content`), and `publishedAt` normalized to ISO-8601. A vertical re
sult prefers the URL, title, and date in its `display` envelope. An entry without a URL or excerpt i
s dropped; the service returns no generated answer, so `content` is omitted. A request's `maxResults
` is rounded up to the smallest accepted `Cnt` — a bound of 8 sends 10 — and the web service enforce
s the final bound by truncating and flagging.
### Failures and recovery
Provider failures — HTTP errors, network failures, unparseable or wrongly structured bodies, and an
error envelope — surface as `WebError` `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`; an aborted request surfaces as `WEB_ABO
RTED`; a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`. HTTP redirects are rejected befo
re the `Location` target is contacted. The provider does not retry or fall back to another backend.
Callers route on the code; the model-facing `web_search` tool surfaces failures to the model under i
ts own error wrapper.
## Development
This project is a standalone extraction of the `web-search-yuanbao` package from the DeepSeek Harnes
s monorepo. It supports the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages from `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.1
-rc.5`, so no monorepo checkout is required; the development dependencies are aligned at `0.2.1-rc.5
c.5`, so no monorepo checkout is required; the development dependencies are aligned at `0.2.1-rc.5`.
Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and pnpm.

The unit suite aliases the package name to `src/index.ts`, so `pnpm test` runs against source withou
t a build. `pnpm test:e2e` self-skips when the key is absent.
## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand
This section explains the design decisions behind the provider; the observable behavior is fully cov
ered in Use this package.
### Design philosophy
The provider is a thin adapter over Yuanbao's Search API with three deliberate rules:
- **Direct retrieval only.** One request per search; no auxiliary model request, unlike the Messages

-backed DeepSeek provider.
- **Portable excerpts only.** A source needs a real URL and excerpt; deri

ving one from other fields would make the seam lie, so unusable entries are dropped.
[该节后续省略]
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
These limits define when the provider is a poor fit. They are current package constraints.
- **Only the query and result count reach the service** — the seam request has no site, mode, indust

ry, or freshness field, so the skill's other controls wait on provider-neutral service fields.
- **A

n entry without a URL or excerpt is dropped entirely** — fewer sources than requested can return.
-
**Dynamic credential availability resolves inside the operation** — the synchronous availability che
ck cannot query the credential store, so a selected keyless provider fails the search with `WEB_PROV

IDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`.
- **An unrecognized date is omitted** — `publishedAt` must be ISO-8601, so
a provider value that neither matches ISO nor `YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm:ss` is dropped rather than passed t
ider value that neither matches ISO nor `YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm:ss` is dropped rather than passed through.
